# Vendored files

Stored with the site so the map works without extra network requests.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `states-albers-10m.json` | [us-atlas](https://github.com/topojson/us-atlas) v3: US state boundaries from the Census Bureau's cartographic boundary files, pre-projected with `d3.geoAlbersUsa().scale(1300).translate([487.5, 305])` | ISC |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | [topojson-client](https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client) v3.1.0 | ISC |
